# sonrai Provider

Manages Sonrai Security platform configuration through the Sonrai GraphQL API.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    sonrai = {
      source  = "sonraisecurity/sonrai"
      version = "~> 0.1"
    }
  }
}

# The token is read from SONRAI_TOKEN. Setting it here instead would write the
# credential into both configuration and state.
provider "sonrai" {
  org = "crc12345678"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `domain` (String) Sonrai console domain. May also be set with `SONRAI_DOMAIN`. Defaults to `sonraisecurity.com`.
- `org` (String) Sonrai organization name, the first label of your console hostname. May also be set with `SONRAI_ORG`.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) Bearer token for the Sonrai API, issued to an App identity. May also be set with `SONRAI_TOKEN`, which is the preferred way to supply it: a token written into configuration is also written into state.
